news.title: AI chip startup Cerebras files for IPO
news.description: In recent months, the company announced an agreement with Amazon Web Services to use Cerebras chips in Amazon data centers, as well as a deal with OpenAI reportedly worth more than $10 billion.

news.title: Anthropic’s relationship with the Trump administration seems to be thawing
news.description: Despite recently being designated a supply-chain risk by the Pentagon, Anthropic is still talking to high-level members of the Trump administration.

news.title: The App Store is booming again, and AI may be why
news.description: New data from Appfigures shows a swell of new app launches in 2026, suggesting AI tools could be fueling a mobile software boom.

news.title: Tinder and Zoom offer 'proof of humanity' eye-scans to combat AI
news.description: The tech aims to identify people's irises and stop the rise of fake accounts and malicious scams.

news.title: OpenAI Executive Kevin Weil Is Leaving the Company
news.description: The former Instagram VP is departing the ChatGPT-maker, which is folding the AI science application he led into Codex.

news.title: AI Drafting My Stories? Over My Dead Body
news.description: AI-assisted writing is creeping into newsrooms under the guise of efficiency. But the trade-off may be more profound than publishers are willing to admit.

news.title: 专访荣耀AI专家李向东：端侧AI方向还没收敛，但AI手机是最好的载体
news.description:
文｜邱晓芬
  编辑｜苏建勋
  2026年，AI正在加速从云端落地到端侧。近期，模型厂商和手机厂商都在背后开始发力——
  3月下旬，国内几大手机厂商几乎同时推送了端侧AI的大规模更新，把原本仅限于旗舰机的AI能力下放到中端和千元机市场。自此，端侧AI终于成为大部分智能手机的标配。
